LESSON: a hash pin over one repo's copy is not a divergence guard against the other repo; it is an edit guard. Pair it with the other side's own BYTES at a named commit (which is what _fixtures__/ldt-parcel-record-slate-8e7218f7.json adds) and, if you want to catch upstream movement, that still needs the other repo in CI.

LESSON: a test can make a stale copy pass DELIBERATELY -- the six-pair absence assertion was correct when written and became the reason nothing failed. When a decision is reversed upstream, invert the assertion (named as such) rather than deleting it; the history is what makes the next reader trust the flip.

DEAD-END: do not compare district sets by `d.district ?? d.id ?? d` -- these tables key districts by `district_name`, and a wrong key reports every district as added+removed. Verify the key against a real file before trusting a delta (this lane reported 87/0 before the fix was applied to its own tool).
